goal: Stop bitcoind from silently continuing startup when configured ZMQ sockets fail to bind
Alert node operators immediately to configuration or port errors instead of dropping notifications
agreement: General support for aborting startup on ZMQ failure (pinheadmz, jeanpablojp)
Verified locally with invalid ports and misconfigurations (pinheadmz, jeanpablojp)
Nonblocking objection to an intermediate helper function, awaiting author reply (pinheadmz)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fixes a silent failure where bitcoind starts despite broken ZMQ notification sockets
Operators currently get no alert when sockets fail to bind due to port conflicts or invalid addresses
